about: Nov 17, 2026 additions to art/busts/v1 (owner: "a few different head shapes ... 2 or 3 more shades ... some more hairstyles"). NOT in the game: the CTO shows the owner first. Every piece is 1254 x 1254 RGBA at (0, 0) on v1's canvas, stacked in v1's order. A head shape keeps v1's bald scalp, ears, eyes, nose and mouth, and the neck where every top meets it, so every v1 top, shirt, tie, jacket and mustache fits every shape unchanged; only the cheeks, jaw and chin change. hairByShape and faceByShape say which painted version of a style a shape wears: "standard" is the v1 (or this round's standard) piece, a shape name is that shape's own refitted piece, named STYLE-SHAPE-COLOR.
proposedCode: bust.ts reads one head set per sex today (heads[tone][age]). To use these, a person also gets a head shape (from the appearance seed or the creator's Head row); heads become heads[shape][tone][age]; a hair or facial-hair file is looked up by hairByShape[style][shape]; the set head box (top, middle, width) stays, because every shape keeps v1's scalp and ears.
doNotCombineAbout: Combinations the checks still flag (1-2 px slivers along a beard or hair edge on a few heads; see README). Until those heads are repainted, a person with one of these heads should not be given that piece.
